# Apatosaurus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Apatosaurus mean?", "deceptive lizard"),
    ("What did Apatosaurus eat?", "herbivore"),

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
